$comment: Sprites the original v0.8.82 atlases hold that the client still draws from survev's SVGs (tools/assets/import.ts uses the original frame for every other one). Mostly defects of the 2026 relaunch's rebuilt atlases: outer dark borders and strokes trimmed away, checked against 2018-2019 wiki cuts of the live atlas. `ownCanvas` lists the kept sprites whose relaunch frame is another canvas than the one the definitions place (cut short at the right/bottom, or cropped): survev's file is drawn at its own logical size (file size x survev's atlas scale) instead of being scaled to the frame's. Names only; no art.
